divergence_localization.summary: DERIVATION DEFECT in the idea record's P1/object, NOT an instrument defect. (a) Swapping byte values between c0 and c1 leaves their XOR difference unchanged on every swapped coordinate, and D E = id on differences, so the instrument's pair-difference trial map in the affine limit is the IDENTITY for every r, S, key: q0^q1 = p0^p1. (b) The record's T_{r,S} = M_r^{-1} Z_{CW[S]} M_r (with Z zeroing the swapped words) is neither the pair difference (identity) nor the one-sided perturbation q0^p0 (which carries the COMPLEMENT mask that keeps the swapped words). (c) The instrument's W counts vanishing PW words of q0^q1 = p0^p1, i.e. W = 4-|A| deterministic on every nontrivial trial; the record's P1 instead counts vanishing words of T(d), a different vector. (d) Even with the corrected keep mask the anchor ranks are 32,32,32,32, so the mask sign is not the only issue.
divergence_localization.what_is_reproduced: The archived anchor itself (D.M=I, ranks 32,0,0,0 of the pair-difference map, W=3 on 100% of nontrivial trials) reproduces exactly under fresh code; the instrument is intact. The archived results.json itself records the swap-invariance step ('The CW[0] ciphertext-byte swap preserves the XOR difference'), which generalizes to every cell and round count and is incompatible with the record's census object.
divergence_localization.forward_guidance_for_repair: A repaired record must either (i) take the affine-limit trial map to be the identity on differences (giving a flat census: P(W>=1)=1 for |A|<=3, 0 for |A|=4, W=4-|A|, no death round within r<=10), or (ii) redefine the measured statistic to the one-sided yoyo iterate q0^p0 with the keep-mask operator and build a probe that actually measures it; in either case the census object must be re-derived before any measurement arm. Stated as repair guidance only; no mechanism conclusion recorded (F1).
